notes.title: Hack the World of Deluded
notes.content:
Ever wanted to press one button and watch all your fantasies become reality? Well, if you've been following us closely, you know there is a way to get some in-game bonuses… but there is a price to pay [i]literally and figuratively[/i]. 

Today we are talking about [i]Cheats[/i] in Deluded. [i]Secret Store[/i] was covered earlier in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3361460?emclan=103582791475075832&emgid=501697399294525586]this post[/url]—don’t miss out!

Here, take a look:

Basically, the cheats allow you to adapt your gameplay to your liking. You want some snow? [b]Here you go.[/b] Don’t feel like completing a quest to lay your hands on a piece of clothing you’ve been eyeing? [b]Wish granted.[/b] Who needs to work out when you can drag a slider and make your butt and back look snatched? You can get infinite stamina, unlock all doors and dialogue options—the possibilities are endless, really. It’s like [i]motherlode[/i] in Sims: addicting, but it takes away a lot of the fun.

[h3][b]How do I open the cheats menu?[/b][/h3]

 Make sure to do the following:

[list]
    [*][b]Download the game version with cheats[/b]
    [*][b]Enable the cheats[/b] at the start of the game
[/list]
    
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/6ec9637dd0fbf27e59babb90b28631f17b17b216.png[/img]
    
[list]
    [*][b]Press F1[/b] to use cheats in the game
[/list]

As of [i]v0.4.1 closed beta[/i] we have [b]an ongoing problem with cheats[/b], they occasionally stop working because of the default and cheat versions clashing; the fix is in progress.

[h3][b]What can I do with cheats?[/b][/h3]

[list]
    [*]Get [b]as much money[/b] as you like (enter the required amount, press [i]Enter[/i]); spawn almost any item you want (it will appear in your inventory; excludes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3361460?emclan=103582791475075832&emgid=501697399294525586]Secret Store[/url]-only items)
    [*]Unlock all [b]dialogue options[/b] [i](works even if you don’t have the required quest items or stats!)[/i][/list]
    
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/03e5c8fe2a4110d5194e794469be46947ac4a394.png[/img]
    
[list]
    [*]Get [b]infinite stamina[/b]—no more getting tired while running
    [*]Have [b]100% chance of triggering random events[/b] and dialogue options
    [*]Change [b]weather and time[/b] (skip time to unlock day/time-specific quests)
[/list]
    
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/d15342886c7fdd4d5b97e2cb6edfc9abd4eddc5b.png[/img]
    
[list]
    [*]Tweak any [b]attribute, skill, need, FX and Alisa’s state[/b] of your liking [i](yes, you can totally go crazy, there are about [b]180[/b] characteristics to change!)[/i]
[/list]

To make things easier, there’s a [b]Favorites[/b] tab. Mark any option (attributes/spawning items section) with a star and you’ll find it all in one place! The [b]search bar[/b] helps you navigate instantly (just type in whatever you are looking for).

[h3][b]Is it worth it to play Deluded with cheats?[/b][/h3]

Depends on what your goal is. If you are looking for a way to [b]wind down after a hard[/b] day, yes, it is. If you want the [b]full experience[/b], where the hardships actually make the gameplay rewarding, then no.

Deluded’s world was designed with gradual progression in mind. Mindlessly jumping through the dialogues, for example, may mar the experience. Maybe—just maybe—take in the world as we built it at least once before going wild with sliders 😉

[h3][b]Can I use the cheats without ruining the experience?[/b][/h3]

[b]If you use it wisely, yes, you can![/b] Experiment with different character builds—test how different stats affect the gameplay without spending too much of your precious time. [i]Pro tip or what I like to do:[/i] [b]keep one save for your main playthrough and a few separate ones[/b] to see the cut-scenes and routes exclusive to the other attributes. Try on funky outfits, change Alisa’s appearance, get some extra money to help yourself out. Just don’t get carried away! [i]...Unless it’s your intention.[/i]

Besides, you don’t have to go “all sliders max” or nothing. Each option can be turned on or off independently, so you can mix a little cheat here and there without unleashing full chaos.

[h3][b]Set up a personal mini-challenge![/b][/h3]

Try tweaking your attributes for a themed run or amplify one side and sacrifice another. You get the maximum [b]GRC[/b] but… can’t spawn items using cheats. I like to call this one [i]High Grace, Low Gear.[/i] Be a true jock: make Alisa muscular and strong, but keep her [b]INT[/b] at zero. Make a name for yourself as a fashionista: get all the fancy clothes, but never wear panties. [i]Wait. That sounds like a good thing.[/i]

[h3][b]Will the cheats version be available on Steam?[/b][/h3]

Still thinking about it, but it will probably come out as DLC. Be advised that [b]achievements in the cheat mode will be disabled![/b]

Most importantly, enjoy yourself. That’s the whole point!


[i]Yours faithfully,
Lantsova[/i]

notes.title: New buildings prototypes in the open world and more…
notes.content:
Another month, another dev update. 

Why no game update?—you might ask. Well, read the full post… you might just be pleasantly surprised 😉

And today we’re gonna talk a lot about the new open-world prototypes, among other things. 

[h3][b]Clothes[/b][/h3]

We’ve imported all the clothes SGogs and MrBrowler have modeled into the game. [b]This includes:[/b] several bras, panties, farmer’s suit and many, many more! If you want to check them out—just hop into our [url=https://discord.gg/jnT4j3XGmy]Discord server[/url] and look up the [b]#sneekers-peekers[/b] channel, [i]available to our server boosters![/i]

[h3][b]NPC schedule[/b][/h3]

In the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3361460/view/532101117967860610?l=english]previous dev update[/url] I talked about finishing up the NPC movement system. Today I can safely say that it’s done and we’ve already set up the paths and animations for all NPCs in the game!

We’ve fixed bugs and problems like: NPCs not stopping when talking to Alisa, NPCs not removing/changing clothes during certain activities (e.g. taking off shoes when lying on a bed), animations misplacements upon loading a save and animations desyncs with props.

[h3][b]Buildings and activities prototypes[/b][/h3]

Work on the open world also never stops, thanks to ArkadiyVicont who’s designing it full-time. Here we’ll talk about some new buildings and activities prototypes that were briefly mentioned in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3361460/view/532101117967860610?l=english]previous dev update[/url].

With these, we plan to add more ways of obtaining goods and money for Alisa. This will also help us diversify gameplay, since ~50% of the quests will be obtainable through doing routine activities and leveling-up attributes in dialogues. We’re aiming to avoid grind just for the sake of the grind, focusing on a meaningful progression path for Alisa. 

Currently we’ve developed the following locations with their jobs and activities: 
[list]
    [*]Silver mine
    [*]Bar (with jobs like dancer, waiter, janitor, cook)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/e2d43b3468057d7cc4cdd3fddedb5be11bc62f0b.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Park-slums
    [*]Farm (some work areas may be seasonal)
[/list]

We have buildings prototypes and are currently developing activities for:
[list]
    [*]Сafe
    [*]Water pumping station
    [*]Crypt and cemetery
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/40c4347b66e0946077e652386e5bb68d5d790973.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/ed1d8437546601dc1e4510a4f8e5a4f41a5870bb.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Workout area
    [*]Store (where you can buy or steal)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/65bfb4179e8fd77a9b5c2dc2d94e13e0c8082878.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Bus station
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/9b468fd39be9691d326ffebd955eefb60b5f7540.png[/img]   
[list]
    [*]Laundry service
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/b7c1bbc4f64ccaf7bff5db8e64e698c77308c29a.png[/img]   
[list]
    [*]NPCs’ houses
    [*]Car wash
    [*]Gas station
    [*]Infirmary
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/305e38ac9bca9ee30e73d10f229c5a1e003e73c0.png[/img]

[h3][b]Mechanics[/b][/h3]

We’ve added nud∗ty checks in the open world logic. When Alisa is walking around nak∗d, people will start calling for local security. Different characters and factions will react to her in their own ways. If Alisa’s L∗∗dness level is low and she’s nak∗d, she’ll be hesitant to interact with others. 

Similar logic will be applied to work uniform checks and interactions with items and objects (similar to interacting with the prayer corner). 

Alisa also won’t be welcome in certain places at all if she’s nak∗d. For example, entering the monastery while wearing little or no clothes will teleport you elsewhere. 

[i]I promised a surprise, didn’t I?[/i] And that is—that [b]we’re finally ready to share a playable test build with our testers (check out our links to find out how you can get access to one)[/b]! Expect one in a couple of days and stay tuned for the news! 🤗

[i]Best regards,
kufe7[/i]

notes.title: Wait, I can’t just walk around naked?!
notes.content:
Another post in our roadmap diaries series, where we talk about future updates in our [url=https://imgur.com/a/RTbhwgx]development plan[/url].


And today we’re gonna talk about the 0.7 update, which would not only mark the end of our 7-day prologue storyline, but more importantly—introduce the Exhibitionism and the Monologue systems!

[h2][b]The Exhibitionism system[/b][/h2]

[b]The Exhibitionism system,[/b] or as we devs prefer to call it, [b]the Privacy system[/b] is one of the most fundamental when it comes to mechanics in Deluded. You've definitely noticed that NPCs don’t express any reactions when Alisa is waltzing around nak∗d. That’s not how it’s supposed to work and the implementation of the Privacy and Monologue systems aims to fix all that. But one thing at a time.

The Privacy system is built around a few key concepts, namely:

[list]
    [*][b]Attributes[/b] such as L∗∗dness, Shame, Stress and Mood
    [*][b]Clothing revealingness level[/b]
    [*][b]Location privacy level[/b]
[/list]

I’ll break them down one by one.

[h3][b]Attributes[/b][/h3]

When it comes to the Privacy system, there are pretty much 4 attributes to consider: [b]Mood, Shame, Stress[/b] and [b]L∗∗dness.[/b] 

You’re already familiar with the two: [b]L∗∗dness[/b] is one of the 8 main attributes, the opposite of Pureness, that can be upgraded via dialogue choices; [b]Mood[/b] is the most important attribute in terms of survival, which works like HP—if it hits zero, it’s [i]game over[/i].

So what are the rest? 

[list]
    [*][b]Shame[/b] reflects how exposed or embarrassed Alisa should feel, based on visible effects like nud∗ty, bodywriting, c∗m, etc. Those effects stack and Shame stays constant until the effects are removed/added. Meanwhile, your Shame level when being nak∗d, covered in c∗m or bodywrite will be lower if you have high [b]L∗∗dness[/b] level.
    [*][b]Stress[/b] works similarly, although it builds up pressure from different sources, like: all needs, the aforementioned Shame, illnesses, cold, dirtiness, etc.
[/list]

In the end, [b]Stress[/b] affects [b]Mood[/b]. The higher Stress is, the faster your Mood will drop and the quicker you will “die”. 

[h3][b]Clothing Revealingness[/b][/h3]

The items in the inventory have their own parameters like Durability, HP, Price, etc, which you can check by hovering a cursor over them and looking at the tooltip. Clothes are also part of the “items” category (obviously), but they have their additional unique parameters such as: Durability, S∗xiness, Wetness… and the [b]Clothing revealingness level[/b] is also one of them. 

Each clothing item that belongs to [b]Top, Bottom, Panties[/b] or [b]Bra[/b] clothes slots has its revealingness score based on:

[list]
    [*]Whether the clothes have or don’t have [b]holes[/b] or [b]cutouts[/b] (by clothing design or damage (HP = 0), so this parameter can be dynamic)
    [*]Are the clothes [b]skimpy[/b]
    [*]Their [b]opacity/transparency[/b]
    [*]This parameter is not yet dynamic but it may be coded as such, like certain clothes materials reacting to changes in [b]Wetness[/b]. So, please, tell us in the comments if you’d love to see this feature added or not 😉
[/list]

Each clothes slot’s revealingness score is summed up for Top clothes and Bottom clothes separately and displayed in the Tab menu. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/ff5a1e29fdf20fcda24f7ccf2cf0a1db498dab46.png[/img]

The total score from all 4 clothes slots affects the Shame level accordingly.

[h3][b]Location Privacy[/b][/h3]

Whether Alisa is walking around nak∗d in a private or public area also affects her Shame differently. I mean, it’s supposed to be ok to undress in her own room, right? 

So, all locations in Deluded will be divided into 3 categories:

[list]
    [*][b]Private[/b] (bathroom, own bedroom)
    [*][b]Semi-private[/b] (forest, abandoned buildings and other places where NPCs are unlikely to wander)
    [*][b]Public[/b] (streets, bar, parents’ room)
[/list]

Being in private locations nak∗d won’t affect you Shame in any way. Being in a semi-private location will affect your Shame by a smaller margin. But if you fall into any NPC’s line of sight, the semi-private location counts as public. And public locations will have your [b]Shame[/b] level skyrocketed… if you don’t have a high enough [b]L∗∗dness[/b] level, of course. 🤭

[i]Hell, why did I write all of this?[/i] The flowchart should sum it up better:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/4c6297db98a84580f4e02510eca66da97f97c6ad.jpg[/img]

[i]Hope my explanations made sense, otherwise—ask away in the comments section![/i] 💬

[i]At the moment of posting this, the privacy system prototype will already be available for testing in the upcoming v0.4, including: Shame, some privacy zones and clothes attributes![/i]

[h2][b]Monologues system[/b][/h2]

And what kind of Privacy system is it without the proper one-liner reactions from the NPCs around? That’s why we decided to include the monologues system alongside it in the v0.7 update.

The system is simple—you step into the NPC’s line of sight and they may comment on your: appearance, nud∗ty, behavior, etc. NPC’s monologues can also be quest-specific and depend on NPC’s faction (e.g., hobos won’t care if your clothes are dirty, but people at the bar will). 

The monologue text lines will appear above NPCs’ heads, much like in Kingdom Come.

We also plan to add the ability to overhear other NPCs’ random monologues and maybe some scripted dialogues.


[i]We already have NPC reactions written out, but as of v0.3.5.1, they only work as dialogues.[/i]


[h2][b]End of the Prologue[/b][/h2]

The 0.7 update—the final 7th day of the prologue. Not much we can say about that without spoiling the story. But I can give you a little sneak peek about what’ll happen [i]after[/i] the prologue when the game becomes truly open-world ([i]yay![/i]).

The story after the prologue will revolve around learning about Adelina, the lab (from the [b]Beneath Familiar Floors[/b] quest) and how Alisa can get back home. 

The stats that you’ve built up during the prologue will carry over into the open world, though the main attributes will be capped at the maximum of 25 points.

Or if you decide to skip the prologue (during the ride from the cemetery), you’ll get to customize your character via dialogue choices during that very ride.

But, of course, the final and ultimate prologue completion will come at the v0.8 where we’ll do a massive polishing of balance, QoL and all that good stuff, but that’s a topic for the next roadmap post ([i]stay tuned![/i])


[i]As usual, let us know your opinion about these mechanics in the comments![/i] 👇


[i]Best regards,
kufe7[/i]

notes.title: How to get Exclusive Clothes and Toys in Deluded
notes.content:
Did you know we have an in-game feature called [i]a Secret store[/i]? It’s a magical place with a bunch of clothes, accessories and toys. [i]You can learn how to get the game build with the Secret store by following our links below 👇![/i] There is quite some exclusive stuff we’ve been working hard for and things you may have missed while completing (or skipping) the quests. Pretty rad, right?

Read the post till the end if you want to find answers to the most frequently asked questions about the Secret store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/fbbf111e539ad405c9202977f9df480b78e4084d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/8f2e3c000fcf4faedb0463e78aff96cdb02e989f.png[/img]

[h3][b]How does the Store look in the game?[/b][/h3]
If you managed to access this super-secret store, this is how it works.

[b]Step one:[/b] get your ass to the landline (it’s on the table in the living room) and choose the [i]Call  Secret store[/i] option 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/b559994276798a79c86756569e7acf2fc2f853ed.jpg[/img]

Boom! You ended up in a lighthouse full of wonders. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/6b4362170cbb53cff3d3906d892d6ed4a4ad563d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Updated Lindcliff plan, Character customization and more…
notes.content:
[i]Nooooooo, a dev update again?! 😫 But it’s been so long since the last release…[/i]

Yeah, I know—I know… Everyone’s waiting for something new to play. Believe me—I’m just as eager as you’re 😅 So, today I wanted to kick off this post by giving you more insights into what we’re working on and why it’s taking so long.

Deluded is not an easy game to make. It consists of complex systems and a complicated storyline. Just to give you an idea, last time I checked—our game had a whopping number of [b]247 character attributes[/b]! 😱 But that’s not something to brag about—and is not the point. 

The point is, for the project as complex as Deluded we intentionally chose a pretty restrictive [url=https://imgur.com/a/RTbhwgx]roadmap[/url] approach where each major update focuses on developing a single large gameplay system. And this comes with consequences such as less frequent updates. 

Why’s that? You see, adding a new system is not as simple as just tossing in some new lines of code. It also means reworking a lot of older systems so they stay compatible. During this process we basically rewrite large chunks of the game’s logic, always breaking and fixing something until it finally works as intended. And there you should see where this lack of game updates comes from—we just can’t release something mid-dev with broken or half-baked game systems. Because we know how frustrating it’s gonna be for players to crawl through a pile of bugs and crashes, assuming the game is even gonna launch at all. 😅 

But let’s imagine we just changed our way of development. We could pump out new content—scenes, clothes etc every month or so. And later, because we slapped this content onto unfinished systems and had a shaky game foundation, [i]boom[/i]! We’d end up with a technical debt bigger than your mom’s…. [i]khm[/i]. Well… and now we have no choice but to do the whole game refactor, rewrite a shitload of code, delay content updates, disable content that doesn’t work anymore, etc… while you, our fans, get disappointed and lose interest in the game, we ourselves lose motivation and… You see where I’m going. And all of this because of what? Because we didn’t bother to implement all the fundamentals from the get-go.

How many games do you know that have fallen into the same trap and never recovered?

We say [i]fuck that,[/i] we’d rather be upfront with you—there’s stuff that needs to be done in order for the whole game not to fall apart. Because I believe that’s not what you want. Because Deluded deserves better. Think of it as if we’re doing the “rework” before the need for rework becomes imperative.

Currently we’re still working on the NPC schedule system—or, to be precise, the final NPC movement subsystem. According to our lead devs, it's the last most complicated one in the game. That means the rest of the mechanics are either easier to build or are already partially implemented (e.g. we already did some work on the character customization, the radial menu and the privacy system mechanics). Once that’s wrapped up, we do hope to push out more frequent updates—but, of course, I can’t promise anything concrete.

But what we’re sure about is that you—yes, YOU—our devoted supporters, who continue to stick around, are the best in the world. The enormous amount of trust you put in us is priceless, and we continue to work on this game every damn day to make up for it.

So, yeah, to repeat myself—Deluded is not an easy game to make. It’s ambitious and it promises a lot, some may even say too much. But we wouldn’t want it any other way. Because otherwise it won’t be the game of our dreams. Of your dreams. It won’t be the game YOU want to see from us. It won’t be the game you’re supporting us for.

But don’t worry. Good news is, we’ve optimized our processes in a way that the development of systems/mechanics and content go in parallel. No time wasted—which means, get ready to be buried under a big pile of new content 😊

[i]Speaking of which…[/i]

[h3][b]Content[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]We finished making the final parts of the new [b]gloor[/b] scene and are now polishing it, adding SFX and missing decals
    [*]The writer started working on [b]another gloor scene[/b] that’ll take place in a [b]fantasy[/b] setting and feature a [b]shrink[/b] flavor
[/list]
[h3][b]New building[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]Made a new hangar/warehouse building for the open world
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/635820f70eb78ce8c277025f6fd2399563df9943.png[/img]

We continue working on adding attributes and functions for character customization. This time, we made some backend attributes for:
[list]
[*] Whip marks
[*] Bruise marks
[*] Tan
[*] Nails
[list]

[list]

[/list]
As for their visual representation, we’ve only made them for legs and cl∗t so far. You can also check out the visual we made for nip∗∗es and nails in the previous dev update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/b2ff87546e851eb816ead0b42379d7620a8e4599.png[/img]

All these attributes will be available for testing via the cheats menu, but not all of them will have functionality or visuals yet, because those are planned for the v0.5.

We’re also adding [b]pills[/b] scattered across some open world locations (and available in the cheats menu) for adjusting those attributes—like Calf width pills, Freckles fade pills, Lips size pills, and 10 more types of pills.

[h3][b]Open world[/b][/h3]
Updated the Lindcliff town plan, adjusting its level design to make the town more complex but still easy to navigate for the player early on. We made sure to allow the players to gradually explore the town without making the experience too overwhelming. For example, we added some secret and hard-to-access paths, but also places with some basic survival options. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/6d1fe31a2c4fe3a52866045bd9967b2736cf89ca.jpg[/img]

Added and mapped out buildings like church, motel, gas station, abandoned houses, residential houses and others. Currently working on attaching activities to them.

In terms of architecture, we’re aiming to make Lindcliff a blend of rural, industrial and occasionally medieval styles. 

The [b]Silver mine[/b] (aka the [b]Prison)[/b] is also in active development, and we’ve implemented the following activities:
[list]
    [*]Playing rock-paper-scissors with inmates
    [*]Retrieving daily items from the cart
    [*]Growing mushrooms (quest)
    [*]Finding hidden escape routes
[/list]
[h3][b]Mechanics[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]Added logic for [b]gloor fog-polluted zones[/b], being inside which will negatively affect your [b]Energy[/b]
    [*]Added the logic to check if the place you slept in was comfortable. This may affect your sleep performance
    [*]Running now removes excessive dirt from the body—but only down to 75 points
    [*][b]Gloor flavors tags[/b]:
    [list]
[*] Just like the items and the clothes, the gloor vials (the drug you can ingest and watch h-scenes) will also have tags to indicate the flavors they feature. For example, when hovering over a gloor vial in your inventory, you might see tags like “hardcore”, “feet”, “latex”, “chastity”, etc, so you know what to expect beforehand 😉
[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]New character[/b][/h3]
The camping location will feature a new side character: Macy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/5e4607a54f9c22b12c376bb5d9709c89120c42f4.png[/img]

[h3][b]Clothes[/b][/h3]
Imported the models of all new clothes into the game and here’s what they look like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/dc126def88c3cece2e1e2c05fd596cdc126890cb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/b00b0853c36cdb083867b52db99b701b6283e207.png[/img]

[i]That’s all for this month’s dev update! Thanks again to our dear supporters and I’m wishing you all a happy and productive summer. 😉[/i]

[i]Best regards,
kufe7[/i]

notes.content:
Continuing our series of posts about the [url=https://imgur.com/LZyu6EI]roadmap[/url], where we explain in detail the meaning of each milestone towards creating the adult game of our dreams!  

Today's topic is the version 0.6 and [b]the actions menu.[/b] Now we are cracking open the mystery so that you can learn how it works! As of this post and the upcoming version 0.4, it's a prototype, so things may change throughout the development.

You can find the previous posts in the series [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3361460]here[/url].

[h3][b]Coming in Deluded v0.6: Actions menu (also known as radial menu)[/b][/h3]

[b]The radial menu[/b] is something many games have, and ours is not unique here. Starting in v0.4, you’ll be able to activate it by clicking the [i]radial menu item[/i] in your inventory (available in the open-world prototype). Later on you'll be able to use it by pressing [i]Q.[/i] It allows the player to perform actions anywhere in the world... With some limitations attached. We don’t have the visual in-game prototype yet, but you can imagine what it looks like—a circle with a center button and options spread out around it.

[h3][b]Actions accessible via the menu[/b][/h3]

There are some [b]generic[/b] ones and [b]attributes[/b] related ones. By default you can:

[list]
    [*][b]Sleep[/b]
    [*][b]Pee[/b]
    [*][b]Wait[/b]
    [*][b]Pleasure yourself[/b] (if Alisa is Hor*y).
[/list]
The attribute-specific perks that appear when you've leveled them up enough are the following: 

[list]
[*] 🟣 [b]LE*D ≥ 75.[/b] Alisa gains a new Actions menu option: [b]Prostitution[/b] (available anywhere, unless there are no people around)
[*] ⚪ [b]PURE ≥ 75.[/b] Alisa gains a new Actions menu option: [b]Pray[/b] (available anywhere, no ritual items needed)
[*] [b]🔴 STR ≥ 50.[/b] Alisa gains a new Actions menu option: [b]Work out[/b] (available anywhere)
[*] 🔵 [b]SUB ≥ 25.[/b] Alisa gains a new Actions menu option: [b]Beg[/b] (available anywhere, but it won’t get you anywhere if there is no one around, duh)
[*] 🟡 [b]GRC ≥ 25.[/b] Alisa gains a new Actions menu option: [b]Dance in public for money[/b] (available anywhere, but no people around=no profit)
[/list]
[h3][b]Hold on! Can’t let ya roam freely now[/b][/h3]

To put it shortly, you don’t want to be running around seducing people in public places. I mean, you can, but that will increase the Stress, which affects the MOOD. If you are not careful enough, that will result in [i]game over[/i]. 

Also, remember the [b]Privacy system[/b] we talked about [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3361460/announcements/detail/501696744517533787]earlier[/url]? That affects the radial menu gameplay as well. [b]Low-privacy[/b] (public) areas provide a bigger chance to encounter a wealthier client (thus bringing you more money) and it’s less likely to get into trouble. 

[h3][b]And something else…[/b][/h3]

You can’t provide intimate services if there is no one around. I know, bummer. You can have fun yourself though, if you really feel like it and have the Hor*y effect active. Sleeping in a public place will put you in danger. Just a heads-up, don’t say I didn’t warn you.

In low-privacy areas the way Alisa's pleasuring herself depends on her LE*D level:

[list]
    [*][b]LE*D 0–25:[/b] she can do it only while fully clothed;
    [*][b]LE*D 26–50:[/b] she can remove her underwear;
    [*][b]LE*D 51–75:[/b] she can drop her top;
    [*][b]LE*D[/b] [b]76–100[/b] will let her do it nude.
[/list]

That sums it up nicely. Got any questions? Hop in the comments below!


[i]Yours faithfully,
Lantsova[/i]

notes.title: The Character Сustomization system
notes.content:
We are continuing our series of posts about the roadmap, where we explain in detail what each checkpoint in our development [url=https://imgur.com/LZyu6EI]roadmap[/url] entails.

This time we’re talking about the “Character customization” system. 

You can read the previous roadmap post about the “NPC schedule” system [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3361460/view/501695476544831793]here[/url].

Character customization is one of the most requested features from you and the one that’s being talked about the most. 

[h3][b]Character customization in Deluded[/b][/h3]

It’s a system that’ll allow you to change different aspects of Alisa’s appearance. Before continuing with the topic I wanna make something very clear: there is a difference between “character customization” and “character creation”. Deluded will have the first but [b]not the second.[/b] Deluded is Alisa’s personal story, so you’ll be able to shape Alisa’s appearance only through gameplay mechanics, quests and interactions, [b]not[/b] create the character from scratch or edit her with sliders. 

I’m sure someone was expecting the character creation to be implemented, but it is how it is and it’s not subject to change.

[h3][b]Features[/b][/h3]

So, which aspects of the character will actually be customizable? 

[list]
    [*][b]Make-up[/b] (for eyes and cheeks) and [b]lipstick.[/b] It's already in the game, but we’ll of course add more patterns totaling to about 20-30 make-up styles in the complete game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/f1e4809423c0a9dab3bce2c6760903f49f030e26.png[/img]
    [*][b]Nails[/b]. In one of the boxes you can find a make-up kit bag, which will contain nail appliances among other things in the future. Use it to change nails’ shape and color.
    [*][b]Brows[/b] that you can color at home and have shaped by a brow artist.
    [*][b]Tattoos[/b] and [b]piercing[/b] — for some reason, the most requested features from you guys 😀. Tattoos and piercing can be done by local artists, and those skills probably won’t be able to be acquired by Alisa herself. Piercing and tattoos will have predetermined slots, that you’ll be able to fill using the dialogue or some other system.
    [*][b]Hairstyle[/b]. Some easy hairstyles (buns, ponytails…) can be done at home, while for more complex ones (haircuts and hair dyes) you have to go to the hair salons in the open world.
    [*][b]Fatness[/b] and [b]muscle tone[/b]. Overeating leads to fat gain, while training helps reduce fat and build muscle. Easy. Different workout stations have different progression levels. Currently, you can use the basement home gym to increase your strength up to a maximum of 30 points. If you want more, you need to seek something better in the open world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/ee6496f884a5ffe417e6637ed0cdccd38e1b7921.png[/img]
    [*]Beauty augmentations like [b]lips[/b], [b]butt[/b], [b]chest[/b] and maybe a [b]face shape.[/b] Will probably be done through visiting the cosmetologist in the open world or by taking special pills.
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/eb8086d2ed72399cbd52a91ec9132f7000134af4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/eb8086d2ed72399cbd52a91ec9132f7000134af4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/d1b3d8a1f65d4789299fde6d05cb617a778c71bf.png[/img]
    [*][b]Pubic hairstyle.[/b] At the moment, there’s only 1 pubic hairstyle in the game. In total, there’ll be 8 styles, including a full shave and a full bush.
    [*][b]Tan[/b] and [b]skin whitening[/b]. Temporarily darkens (with the sun or a tanning bed) or whitens (with special lotions) your skin. The effect should last for about 2 in-game weeks. I hope we’ll be able to implement the tan marks system as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/bcf6c2facf50e1d6ed04a65cce009f1d062f1558.png[/img]
    [*][b]Aging[/b]. If you play long enough, you’ll see Alisa’s face slowly developing wrinkles. Btw, you can already test the visuals in the cheats version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/06b2d8cd02e654503ce6b6578e5301051afe6d60.png[/img]
[/list]
[h3][b]Progression[/b][/h3]

Of course, not all character customization options will be available immediately. E.g. applying certain make-up patterns already requires some make-up skill in 0.3.5.1. Other customizations that require skill will include: lipstick, hairstyle, pubic hairstyle, brows and nails. 

Skills can leveled up by simple practice or by reading special journals, with 4 journals for each skill scattered across the open world.

It works the other way too, like make-up increasing the S**iness level.

Certain customizations will be tied to attributes. E.g you can’t have “dominant” tattoos if your Dominance is not high enough.

Also, the customizations will be tied to certain areas and NPCs.

[h3][b]When will it be implemented?[/b][/h3]

The game already partially has the code and features for character customization, but the 0.5 build will have the whole functionality. 

Of course, most of the customization features will be available in the open world, but we’ll make sure to add more ways to test this mechanic in 0.5, like: asking mom to do Alisa’s hair, using mirror, etc…


Anything else I didn’t mention you wanna learn about? Let me know in the comments! 😉


[i]Best regards,
kufe7[/i]

Nails. In one of the boxes you can find a make-up kit bag, which will contain nail appliances among other things in the future. Use it to change nails’ shape and color.
Brows that you can color at home and have shaped by a brow artist.

Tattoos and piercing — for some reason, the most requested features from you guys 😀. Tattoos and piercing can be done by local artists, and those skills probably won’t be able to be acquired by Alisa herself. Piercing and tattoos will have predetermined slots, that you’ll be able to fill using the dialogue or some other system.
Hairstyle. Some easy hairstyles (buns, ponytails…) can be done at home, while for more complex ones (haircuts and hair dyes) you have to go to the hair salons in the open world.

Fatness and muscle tone. Overeating leads to fat gain, while training helps reduce fat and build muscle. Easy. Different workout stations have different progression levels. Currently, you can use the basement home gym to increase your strength up to a maximum of 30 points. If you want more, you need to seek something better in the open world.
Beauty augmentations like lips, butt, chest and maybe a face shape. Will probably be done through visiting the cosmetologist in the open world or by taking special pills.
Pubic hairstyle. At the moment, there’s only 1 pubic hairstyle in the game. In total, there’ll be 8 styles, including a full shave and a full bush.

Tan and skin whitening. Temporarily darkens (with the sun or a tanning bed) or whitens (with special lotions) your skin. The effect should last for about 2 in-game weeks. I hope we’ll be able to implement the tan marks system as well.
Aging. If you play long enough, you’ll see Alisa’s face slowly developing wrinkles. Btw, you can already test the visuals in the cheats version.

Of course, not all character customization options will be available immediately. E.g. applying certain make-up patterns already requires some make-up skill in 0.3.5.1. Other customizations that require skill will include: lipstick, hairstyle, pubic hairstyle, brows and nails.
Skills can leveled up by simple practice or by reading special journals, with 4 journals for each skill scattered across the open world.
It works the other way too, like make-up increasing the S**iness level.
Certain customizations will be tied to attributes. E.g you can’t have “dominant” tattoos if your Dominance is not high enough.
Also, the customizations will be tied to certain areas and NPCs.
The game already partially has the code and features for character customization, but the 0.5 build will have the whole functionality.

Of course, most of the customization features will be available in the open world, but we’ll make sure to add more ways to test this mechanic in 0.5, like: asking mom to do Alisa’s hair, using mirror, etc…

notes.title: Social Survival in Deluded
notes.content:
Time for another diary entry!

Giving you another glimpse into our plans to make Deluded as immersive and well-thought-out as possible!

Hope you didn’t forget that Deluded is not only [b]RPG[/b], but also [b]survival[/b]. [i]But what does survival actually mean in the world of Deluded? What purpose does it serve? Why add survival to a game like this at all?[/i]

That’s what I wanted to talk about today. 

Imagine a typical survival game. You explore unknown locations, gather resources like wood, rocks and then you craft weapons, instruments from it to further explore, level up and survive.

Now imagine this game: to gather resources and survive, you don’t just go around collecting things, but you communicate with people, build relationships, trade with them, taking into account their personal needs and their character.

Deluded embraces classic survival principles while including a social element in it. 

[h3][b]How does social survival work in Deluded?[/b][/h3]

After the prologue Alisa finds herself in an unknown place, and at first the NPCs living there don’t trust her, because Alisa doesn’t have any reputation in the area. Unlike typical survival games, where you chop trees and mine for ore, here, you have to study the NPCs — their factions, behaviors, and needs — to secure your place in the world.

NPCs belong to different factions: [b]troublemakers, cultists, bandits, thieves, hobos, farmers[/b] and [b]commoners[/b]. Each group has its own values, goals, and attitudes toward outsiders. Some will give you work, others will take advantage of you, and some will want nothing to do with you — at least, not until you prove yourself.

In the world of Deluded people are the main resource. Your attributes influence the relationships with people, and your relationships influence the access to resources.

But survival isn’t just about keeping Alisa fed and warm — it’s about managing how others perceive her. Your skills, appearance, and actions determine which doors open for you and which slam shut.

[h3][b]RPG stats[/b][/h3]

Your RPG stats play a big role in how you navigate this world. Here are some examples:

[list]
    [*][b]Playing as a PURE character[/b] (focused on innocence and morality) is a hardcore choice. It locks out some options, such as using charm or seduction to persuade NPCs, forcing you to rely on wit and physical skills. But it also opens doors — certain factions, like cultists, may respect you more, and you might gain advantages in uncovering some secrets.
    [*][b]A high INTELLECT character[/b] will be better at solving puzzles, spotting hidden details, and making smart trades, but might struggle with physical confrontations.
    [*][b]A SUBMISSIVE character[/b] avoids major conflicts but has fewer resources and must rely on persuasion and luck to get by.
    [*][b]A DOMINANT character[/b] is bold but faces higher risks. You’ll have to compensate with either strength (to fight) or manipulation (to control others).
    [*]A [b]FOOLISH[/b] [b]character[/b] implies better communication with lower classes of society (e.g. understanding the drunkards’ speech), lesser negative effects (due to a carefree attitude) and getting involved in numerous silly situations.
[/list]

Each approach creates a different survival experience.

[h3][b]Difficulty waves[/b][/h3]

Your struggles won’t remain the same throughout the game. As you progress, new challenges arise:

[list]
    [*][b]Lindcliff society changes[/b], and at first, people are merely suspicious of you. But as unexpected events occur (no spoilers!) — their distrust turns to hostility. Earn their trust in time, or surviving in this city will be brutal.
    [*][b]Winter hits[/b], and living on the streets becomes much harder. Securing steady work and shelter becomes crucial.
    [*][b]Acreton opens up[/b], a more prosperous location, but one where everything is incredibly expensive. You’ll need status or wealth to thrive there.
[/list]

So, that’s how things are regarding the social survival game design in Deluded. Not all of these features might be implemented yet, but we just wanted to share our vision. Hopefully, you find them interesting! Looking forward to your interesting questions in the comments! 😉


[i]Best regards,
kufe7[/i]

notes.title: How Attributes Define Your Gameplay
notes.content:
Since the beginning of the [b]Deluded[/b] development, we have not only released numerous beta builds, but also written a lot of devlogs. While reading all of them, you might’ve realized how complex Deluded already is and how more advanced it is shaping up to be. [i]Surely it must take a lot of planning?—[/i] you probably thought. Well… of course! Planning, mapping, outlining, drafting… is what takes a huge chunk of our work time. But it’s worth it, since it helps us ensure we make as few mistakes along the way as possible!

We’ve been thinking thoroughly about Deluded’s game loop, gameplay pillars and such. So, in this particular post, we’d like to talk about each of the [b]8 main attributes[/b], our ideas regarding their perks, buffs, debuffs and quirks. Sorry, [i]not just our[/i] ideas… Because we couldn’t have done it without your help, guys! Thanks to the [b]Helper[/b] folks in our Discord for sharing your invaluable thoughts!

By the way, if you want to take part in the development and influence some of our decisions, you can do so by grabbing a [b]@Helper[/b] role on our [url=https://discord.gg/jnT4j3XGmy]Discord[/url]. From time to time, we provide tasks like this, do polls, ask questions, make testing requests etc.

So, without further ado, let’s dive into this! Below are all of the main attributes with lists of their features. Each attribute’s progression level (0-100) is divided into 4 stages, each stage unlocking unique gameplay additions. Those can be:

Stress is pretty much constant and represents the sum of all negative effect imposed on Alisa. notes.title: The NPC Schedule system
notes.content:
Hey! This is one of the older posts, I just wanna leave it there and some more posts later for history. Don’t mind 😉

[hr][/hr]
We've noticed quite a few questions popping up from your feedback, such as: Will we be able to customize the character? Why are all NPCs idle? Why can’t I go to the town? And the most popular: When is the Steam release? 

Those questions mean that you really want to see this project flourish and we appreciate them! However, we couldn’t understand where these questions come from, given that the roadmap containing those milestones has been available since the very first release.

In order to make a statement that [url=https://i.imgur.com/LZyu6EI.png]it does exist[/url] and to develop the subject further, we’re starting a series of posts covering the roadmap in detail so that everyone can learn more. 

Overall, the current roadmap is focused on the house quests and events, We took this opportunity to focus on the small playable area, where it is convenient to test all the game mechanics. Yeah, mechanics. This roadmap is mostly focused on the technical part of the game. Of course, that doesn’t mean we will sacrifice the content part, mechanics and content are being worked on by different people. But developing and refining mechanics will be our priority for now. As they say, without the base, there can be no superstructure.

So, let’s talk about the nearest roadmap milestone - the 0.4 update!

[h3][b]v0.4 - NPC Schedule[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/256323c506ed7854b87542a67be29cad7f1d9e20.png[/img]

The next big update will focus on adding the NPC scheduling functionality. The NPCs will be able to walk between locations, sleep, work, eat, change clothes, etc. Though, no advanced AI or anything. Since Deluded doesn’t have enemies and combat mechanics, we think it’s unnecessary. 

Each NPC will have its main and side activities. The main activity is when an NPC is the most available for your interaction. Sometimes they switch to a side activity, but not for a long time (30 mins of in-game time).

Here’re the rough schedules we have for our existing NPCs.

[h3][b]Mother[/b][/h3]

Willa Ginart, being a busy bee, will be working in the kitchen - washing dishes or cooking as her main activity. Her side activities would include: reading in bed, bathing and ironing.

[h3][b]Father[/b][/h3]

Jeff Ginart, on the other side, is a couch potato. He will occasionally read the newspaper trying to find a job and his other side activities will include: chugging beer, bathing, watching TV.

You’ll also be able to join him for a drink (don’t be jealous, US players 🙈).

[h3][b]Brother[/b][/h3]

Stuart’s main activity will remain sitting on a porch as it is now. Side activities are: playing on the console, returning from hustle-work.

[h3][b]Mr. Alan[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/93d1d035e94638fc783ae9804a4f01627705db91.png[/img]

Mr. Alan will be staying in the shelter (church) and coming every day to stand by the tree. From there you can continue dialogues and quests with him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/42d25274df65f7463a0d0a370cef7b303e843472.png[/img]

In the evening the whole family will dine together at the table. You’ll have the choice to either join or pass.

[h3][b]Dialogues[/b][/h3]

The current activity and location of the NPC will also influence the interactions. NPCs will talk about things differently when they’re not engaged in their main activity. For example, mom will get angry if you enter the bathroom while she’s bathing.

[h3][b]Reactions[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/d8c8b226548afe5cdbc6a49b76b424c3aebb6425.png[/img]

Ever been confused about why is Alisa walking naked so freely in front of the family? Not anymore. Well… sort of. You’ll see the full-fledged version of it when we introduce the 0.7 update, but we’ll get to that. With the 0.4 NPCs will be able to react to different states of Alisa and her appearance. We’ve modeled 13 universal reaction types for each NPC, which include reactions to 8 various types of nakedness (underlined). That being:

[list]
    [*]In Restraints (eg. ropes, cuffs)
    [*]Naked in Restraints
    [*]Fully Naked
    [*]Visible Genitals + Nipples
    [*]Visible Genitals
    [*]Visible Nipples
    [*]Dirty
    [*]Visible Panties
    [*]Visible Bra
    [*]Cum on face
    [*]Drunk
    [*]Sexy
    [*]Aroused
[/list]

The Sexy parameter is measured by the sexiness and beauty of Alisa’s outfit combined with the character’s attribute ‘Sexiness’.

Since NPCs are unique, they will react to these states differently. For example, one NPC may find Alisa being naked as sexy, another will say she’s a whore. In the cases when an NPC is not unique -we’re talking about NPC fractions - those fractions will also have their own reaction pattern (we’ll talk more about fractions in the post about v0.9).

[h3][b]New NPCs[/b][/h3]

There’s a list of other NPCs that we plan to add in the prologue (not necessarily in 0.4): 

[list]
    [*]Stuart’s girlfriend
    [*]Stuart’s best friend
    [*]Alisa’s friends
[/list]

Some of them are quest- or event-related and not all of them will have a schedule.

[h3][b]Other[/b][/h3]

A minor rework due to the introduction of NPC schedule system would be that the “Dirty girl” quest will only activate if Stuart is present in his room.

And, of course, not forgetting the Spring Mansion location. All the family members will receive their unique schedules on the camping day.

And that’s about it!

I don’t think I’ve covered all the features that’ll be present in 0.4, or some features are not fully confirmed. For example, we’re not sure yet if the type and order of activities will change from day to day. 

Do you have any questions regarding NPC schedule? 

Please, leave them in the comments below!

We’ve decided to start these devlogs to talk about more about the game besides what’s currently being worked on. And we would like to ask you: what can we cover in these posts? Is there any game aspect you would like to know more about? Suggest your topics in the comments as well! 


[i]Best regards,
kufe7[/i]

Alright, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3361460/view/501694842286376544?l=english]April Fools fun's over[/url]—here comes the actual update 😁

Make sure to check out the other three full-length posts about the 0.4 update! [i](Can’t link them here on Steam, but I’m sure you can find ’em)[/i]

[i]And now, the new stuff…[/i]

[h3][b]New content[/b][/h3]

We finished the "[b]Silent Observer[/b]" quest (fixing the TV) and added a new interaction with Violet (Alisa’s friend).

There’s a new mini-quest called [b]“Dad’s Errand[/b]” where Alisa can ask dad to buy her a gift. Another one is [b]“No room for spiders”[/b] where dad asks Alisa to clear the cobwebs around the house for some cash.

Added a few new items, such as:

[list]
    [*][b]Bullet vibrator[/b]
[/list]
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/efa0886e5677afcdc3f962ac8d6d1aff483ff948.png[/img]
[list]

[/list]
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/628012004183960594dfb2d62d110207480a4223.png[/img]

We've also reworked the easel interaction. Now the painting you pick actually shows up on the canvas (using AI placeholders for now—those will be replaced later).


One more thing that’s still in the works is a [b]Webcam quest[/b]. This one probably won’t make it into 0.4—it’s only about 20% complete—but it’s too fun not to mention.

We’re creating quite an activity centered around becoming a [b]webcam model[/b]. It will be kinda similar to what we had in our previous game (if you know you know), but way more advanced.

You’ll need to [b]build a PC[/b] from scratch—assembling components like the CPU, GPU, motherboard, PSU, CD drive, and an Internet modem. Parts will come in different quality levels, so no two builds will feel exactly the same.

We’ve already prototyped a system for tracking subscribers, views and PC upgrades logic. If Alisa has high [b]Intelligence[/b], she’ll be much faster at putting the PC together.

The webcam model career isn’t the only reason to have a PC—you’ll also be able to [b]play games, stream, chat on live streams, browse the web, shop, apply for jobs, watch porn, explore illegal websites, donate to the church, and even learn Latin[/b].

[h3][b]New clothes[/b][/h3]

[b]SilverGogs[/b] made a new mini-top and is making a cultist outfit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/5c35b5b592514078e528c640756a3922cd3f3569.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/6f6c4c698b0103fd9454378169a1aa113aaeaf22.png[/img]

[h3][b]Attributes and Mechanics[/b][/h3]

Our programmer is still sweating over the NPC system.

NPCs can now engage in scheduled tasks throughout the day. These can trigger [b]animation changes, hide certain objects[/b] temporarily, or spawn [b]animated objects[/b] for the duration. 

There are also [b]spatial sounds[/b] for activities and the system to track [b]how many NPCs are in each location[/b] (this info might be used by the privacy system or others)

[list]
    [*]Added early versions of [b]Gloor[/b] and [b]Alcohol addiction[/b] effects. Both effects work similarly. Once addicted, you have to satisfy the urge or you'll gain [b]Stress[/b] points. You can either go to the doctor or tough it out until the effect wears off
    [*]Added the [b]Blindfolded[/b] effect for a quest. It blacks out everything except a small desaturated circle around Alisa
    [*]Added [b]freezing water[/b] logic and visuals. It now [b]freezes[/b] if the outside temp drops below 0°C
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/bbc48fe10561aa97be9fbc827ca4e4576c09295c.png[/img]
    

[h3][b]Locations[/b][/h3]

Our environment artist is currently improving the [b]labyrinth’s hedge[/b] in the open world Park-Slums area. Here’s how it currently looks in the project; and here's what it's shaping up to be:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/48102f2b9152d4ae02add21d9c982ee1c0da71ad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/30c2b9b41e458e6560e3ba7dfd15909855e3b116.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/ae37ebf21d9155256a4994f5e8cd9ec76f94b6d5.png[/img]

He’s also made more stuff for the [b]Silver mine[/b]’s surrounding area and interior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/4b9ed2a67cdc9e536ca9ce9760ffb794490b51de.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/f01cd1a35796ef62d2a0a4b788f4c790daa5846f.png[/img]

Also, we added a [b]destruction effect to the greenhouse[/b] that is connected to the labyrinth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/d724b0cd617fe0a812d512a5cc202c31a6b5e7d7.png[/img]

And—that’s it! As I’ve said in previous posts, the content part for this update is almost finished. But the complex system that is NPC schedule is the main one that has to be done for the v0.4. We already assigned all the activities for all our NPCs, placed them, added animations and attached sounds. Basically, we’re waiting for the programmer to finish the “rails” system so that NPCs can move between locations and activities. 


[i]Stay tuned for more![/i]


[i]Best regards,
kufe7[/i]

notes.content:
[b]You’ve had your fair share of posts regarding the v0.4 updates,[/b] and today it’s time for yet another one! This time, however, we’re not just talking new content—we’re talking [b]a fundamental shift in core mechanics.[/b]

After deep reflection and having endured waves of negativity and relentless critique, we have decided to [b]remove all explicit content.[/b] We know this won’t please everyone, but we believe this shift will help us reach the players who are actually looking for something deeper—something that resonates on a different level. It also became clear that an adult-focused project simply won’t sustain itself in the way we hoped, so we have to change things up. We're choosing a different direction—a redemptive one. Moving forward, [b]50% of all proceeds[/b] will go to the reconstruction of churches around the world—a small step toward something more meaningful.

These are just a few of the adjustments we’re ready to announce—more to come.
